facts.fact: The Seychelles News Agency reports that the SeyID app, launched in 2022 by the Department of ICT, lets people create a digital identity with an accredited identity app to prove who they are online and is required to access government online services.
DICT presented Mon Servis, the Biz Auth Portal, CertExpress, online driving-licence renewal and SeyID features, all reached through SeyID, per the Seychelles News Agency.
The SeyID app, launched in 2022, gives a digital identity with an accredited identity app that can be used to prove who you are online, per the Seychelles News Agency.
